scope_and_method_literal_excerpt: 在接受GEO所标记培养生物重复为工作假设的前提下，完成TSP1KO与WT各3个培养样本的独立limma比较。保留41345源探针，按预设平台literal-main类别检验33604探针，原探针家族BH<0.05为0。该阴性结果不等于不存在效应。四靶点的原家族BH均未达到0.05。
数据保持提交的RMA log2尺度，不再归一化、不剔除样本。GO/KEGG分析复用冻结小鼠基因集；使用23359个唯一映射代表基因的完整moderated-t排序。GO_BP共5114条、KEGG共342条GSEA结果；GSEA的基因集发现可能反映协调的小幅变化，不能替代探针层面的检验。描述性ORA前景为空，完整受检mapped背景及所有合资格通路保留。
培养来源标记为生物重复，但独立培养制备、分离日期、动物数及混池组成仍未独立核实，因此不能解读为六只动物或体内TSP1效应。作者20900过滤与诊断25519差异仍妨碍原作者精确复现，当前采用的是另行预设33604探针家族。
排序共有23359个基因，精确重复t值计数1，比例1/23359 = 4.2810051800162675e-05（Entrez 100039675和100504515）。fgsea显示0%是百分比四舍五入，并非无并列。GO_BP有13项log2err为NA，另13项P触及eps=1e-10下界；两类13项不假定为同一组。相应GSEA结果受估计警告和数值精度限制，未重跑模型或GSEA。

scope_and_method_literal_excerpt: 已完成并通过有界独立数值审阅。原始RCC共26份，来源报告7例干燥综合征合并干燥性角结膜炎患者、19例健康对照，均为女性；患者单位依赖原来源人数与唯一标签一致的工作假设，未获得外部身份认证或明确重复眼说明。保留全部样本，调整年龄及3个真实RCC技术批次。
按预设方案使用15个管家基因的几何均值缩放原始计数，然后计算log2(归一化计数+1)。这是一套新的独立预处理和模型，不是对作者未知处理因子的复现。579个内源特征中465个进入检验、114个低于预设检测标准，完整受检集合BH<0.05共40个。效应为调整后的变换尺度差值，不是直接的分子丰度倍数。管家基因跨组稳定性仍属假设。
四靶点的状态分别记录于Four_Target_Results.csv：CXCL13仅2份样本高于检测界值，按预设规则不检验；CXCR5不在本面板；PDCD1与CD274已检验但未达到原完整受检集合BH阈值。过滤、面板缺失和未显著不能互相替代。各受检特征均保留效应、SE、原始P、BH及逐特征95%区间。

scope_and_method_literal_excerpt: Executed 2026-10-08 by GPT-6.1-sol under the hash-pinned GPT-6-astra prospective plan and root dispatch. One unit; primary PSS6 versus non-Sjogren sicca6, sensitivity PSS7 versus sicca6; both adjusted for recorded sex with rank3. Sensitivity is nonindependent and exploratory.

The estimand is relative transcript abundance of the deposited captured mixture under TMM normalization. Source-reported distinct patient biopsies are the biological working units; 82,867 source-retained barcode columns are not biological replicates. Cell capture, composition, RNA content, deposited processing and unknown batch may contribute. No cell-intrinsic, absolute tissue expression, healthy-control, causal, or independent-replication claim is supported. Cross-study SCP738/SDY1765 overlap is unknown.

Published two alignment/QC failures and one sicca exclusion cannot be assigned uniquely to the deposited subjects; timing and identities remain UNKNOWN. Deposited Cellranger integer aggregates do not establish raw-droplet identity, author Scrublet/final QC, or author final-flow reproduction. Mitochondrial and capture-cell metrics are descriptive, not model covariates or offsets. TMM composition and negative-binomial/QL variance assumptions are working assumptions; count normality testing is not a prerequisite.

Primary edgeR4.8.2 robust QL supplies logFC,F,P and complete-family BH. No primary QL confidence interval was estimated; primary CI fields are NA. Separate limma3.66.0 voom effect, SE and pointwise95%t interval belong to a secondary exploratory family. Different significance between primary/sensitivity is not an interaction. Actual nonlegacy edgeR gene-wise df.residual.adj and nominal df.residual were exported from saved objects; df.residual.zeros is absent in this version's nonlegacy fitted object and was not invented. First producer verification expected that absent field and failed; its real log is retained, and the export was corrected without refitting or changing methods.

Frozen GO_BP/KEGG snapshots and org.Hs.eg.db3.22.0 mapping were used without refresh. Only unique Entrez representatives enter pathway analysis; unmapped and multi-Entrez reasons are explicit. Representative choice is actual-comparison total raw count then lexical feature ID, independent of effect/P. GSEA uses signed sqrt(QLF), deterministic numeric Entrez tie order, prescribed fgsea settings and full eligible-term BH. ORA uses every tested uniquely mapped representative as universe, term sizes15-500 after intersection, zero-hitP1 and combinedUP/DOWN BH. No result-driven tuning occurred.

Deposited Cellranger integer aggregates do not establish raw-droplet identity, author Scrublet/final QC, or author final-flow reproduction. Mitochondrial and capture-cell metrics are descriptive, not model covariates or offsets. TMM composition and negative-binomial/QL variance assumptions are working assumptions; count normality testing is not a prerequisite.

Primary edgeR4.8.2 robust QL supplies logFC,F,P and complete-family BH. No primary QL confidence interval was estimated; primary CI fields are NA. Separate limma3.66.0 voom effect, SE and pointwise95%t interval belong to a secondary exploratory family. Different significance between primary/sensitivity is not an interaction. Actual nonlegacy edgeR gene-wise df.residual.adj and nominal df.residual were exported from saved objects; df.residual.zeros is absent in this version's nonlegacy fitted object and was not invented. First producer verification expected that absent field and failed; its real log is retained, and the export was corrected without refitting or changing methods.

Frozen GO_BP/KEGG snapshots and org.Hs.eg.db3.22.0 mapping were used without refresh. Only unique Entrez representatives enter pathway analysis; unmapped and multi-Entrez reasons are explicit. Representative choice is actual-comparison total raw count then lexical feature ID, independent of effect/P. GSEA uses signed sqrt(QLF), deterministic numeric Entrez tie order, prescribed fgsea settings and full eligible-term BH. ORA uses every tested uniquely mapped representative as universe, term sizes15-500 after intersection, zero-hitP1 and combinedUP/DOWN BH. No result-driven tuning occurred.

scope_and_method_literal_excerpt: 48例公开来源标记pSS患者全部保留，高疲劳与低疲劳各24例。使用提交β值，按预先方案转换M值并调整年龄、性别，比较高疲劳减低疲劳。原minfi处理细节、批次和白细胞组成未知；这是提交值层面的探索关联，不复现作者调整细胞组成的模型，不支持细胞内在或因果解释。
485,577个来源探针全部留在结果表，按分析前固定的常染色体/build37、注释SNP、完整β值及检测P条件筛选后，360,960个CpG进入一套BH校正，0个达到BH<0.05。未显著不等于没有关联或充分排除小效应。没有根据结果改变阈值、模型或排除患者。
效应和95%逐特征区间是调整后的log2 β比值比尺度差，即M值差；不是RNA log2FC，也不是甲基化百分比差。另存原β均值差作未调整描述。四靶点注释共65个CpG，其中44个进入检验；保留所有未检验原因，不合并成基因P值，也不从甲基化方向推出表达方向。
官方GPL family包含约230GB内容，下载已中止并保留部分文件；部分文件内的平台表起止标记完整，485,577唯一探针与来源完全对应，所需注释已提取并核验。不能据此声称整个family压缩包或CRC通过。所用注释含build36/37混合，按预设build37规则处理；缺交叉反应字段，探针特异性未全面认证。
